Pannusch Reynolds-number documentation is corrected to use superficial velocity, matching its implementation.
Liang transient kinetics are classified as recoverable but not yet fitted.
New claim-binding audits expose remaining manuscript-to-producer limitations.
uncertainty_changes: Paper-A uncertainty and coverage documentation was expanded.
No new hydraulic measurement-uncertainty record sufficient for an independent WP02 holdout was added.
rights_changes: No new dataset-rights record resolves the Gagne trace redistribution uncertainty.
No newly added dataset changes the adopted Waszkiewicz CC-BY-4.0 data or MIT local-re-expression rights.
units_and_mapping_changes: Pannusch superficial-versus-interstitial velocity semantics were corrected.
Schmieder mean pressure points are distinguished from an ambiguous text-only maximum.
validation_role_changes: No new dataset is promoted to an independently blinded hydraulic-validation role.
New cards are evidence intake, audit, or skip records rather than adopted runtime dependencies.
pressure_and_flow_changes: The Waszkiewicz cross-pressure analysis code changed, but its bound model and source datasets did not.
No independent raw pressure-plus-flow campaign was added.
machine_or_headspace_changes: No new machine/headspace dataset was added.
extraction_or_chemistry_changes: Card and manuscript audits refined interpretation; no new tracked dataset was added.

decision.reason: The review improves evidence semantics but adds no qualifying independent hydraulic holdout and no changed model or dataset required by the frozen v0.2.0 branch.
